intro: Dealing with a wasp, hornet, or yellow jacket nest in your Mamaroneck home or business? The Best Pest Control NYC provides professional stinging insect removal services throughout Westchester County, including all of Mamaroneck. Our licensed technicians specialize in nest identification, treatment, and removal for wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, carpenter bees, and ground-nesting bees — protecting your property from structural damage and repeated stinging incidents.
whyUs: Best Pest Control NYC has served Westchester County for years with certified, experienced technicians who understand the unique pest challenges in Mamaroneck's coastal and suburban environment. We offer same-day service, transparent pricing between $350-$550, and guarantee complete bee removal with follow-up inspections to ensure your property remains bee-free.
localContext: Mamaroneck's beautiful harbor-side properties and historic homes near Harbor Island Park often attract wasps and hornets seeking sheltered nesting spots in eaves, chimneys, wall voids, and older structures. Paper wasp nests appear under roof overhangs, yellow jackets build colonies inside wall cavities and attics, and carpenter bees bore into the wood trim and siding common in the architectural styles throughout Mamaroneck Village and the Town of Mamaroneck — from waterfront estates to the charming residences near Hommocks Park.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Mamaroneck?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

If you discover an active nest on your property, call (855) 930-5016 immediately and we'll dispatch our team to assess the situation and safely treat the nest, typically within 2–4 hours.
